arxiv-2406-19221.title: Quantum-like product states constructed from classical networks
arxiv-2406-19221.creator: Gregory D. Scholes, Graziano Amati
arxiv-2406-19221.description: Abstract Can complex classical systems be designed to exhibit superpositions of tensor products of basis states, thereby mimicking quantum states? We exhibit a one-to-one map between the product basis of quantum states comprising an arbitrary number of qubits and the eigenstates of a construction comprising classical oscillator networks.

arxiv-2412-10610.title: Comparing Large Language Models for supervised analysis of students’ lab notes
arxiv-2412-10610.creator: Rebeckah K. Fussell, Megan Flynn, Anil Damle, Michael F.J. Fox, N. G. Holmes
arxiv-2412-10610.description: Abstract Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) hold significant promise in improving physics education research that uses machine learning. In this study, we compare the application of various models to perform large-scale analysis of written text grounded in a physics education research classification problem: identifying skills in students’ typed lab notes through sentence-level labeling.

arxiv-2508-19042.title: A Concurrent Modular Agent: Framework for Autonomous LLM Agents
arxiv-2508-19042.creator: Norihiro Maruyama, Takahide Yoshida, Hiroki Sato, Atsushi Masumori, Johnsmith, Takashi Ikegami
arxiv-2508-19042.description: Abstract We introduce the Concurrent Modular Agent (CMA), a framework that orchestrates multiple Large-Language-Model (LLM)-based modules that operate fully asynchronously yet maintain a coherent and fault-tolerant behavioral loop. This framework addresses long-standing difficulties in agent architectures by letting intention emerge from language-mediated interactions among autonomous processes.

arxiv-2510-14107.title: Production cross sections of charm-beauty mesons in proton-nucleus and nucleus-nucleus collisions at LHC
arxiv-2510-14107.creator: Madeeha Nazish, Faisal Akram
arxiv-2510-14107.description: Abstract In this work, we calculate the production cross sections of the 1S and 1P states of the B c B_{c} meson for proton-nucleus and nucleus-nucleus colliding beam experiments at LHC and RHIC. We provide estimates for the Au nucleus at RHIC energies and for the Pb and Xe nuclei at LHC energies.

britannica-1911-staunton-sir-george-thom.title: Staunton, Sir George Thomas (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-staunton-sir-george-thom.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-staunton-sir-george-thom.description: Article 'Staunton, Sir George Thomas' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 25), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Staunton (1737–1801), first baronet, diplomatist and Orientalist, and in 1792 accompanied his father, who had been appointed secretary to Lord Macartney's mission to China, to the Far East. He acquired a good knowledge of Chinese, and in 1798 was appointed a writer in the East India Company's factory at Canton, and subsequently its chief.

pmc-11357399.title: Dietary Intake of 14–15-Year-Old Faroese Adolescents by an Online Assessment Tool and Associations with Wellbeing and Health Behaviour
pmc-11357399.creator: Unn Thomsen, Anna Sofía Veyhe, Marin Strøm, Antonios Dakanalis, Andrew P Hills
pmc-11357399.description: There is robust evidence linking diet and physical activity to major public health concerns such as cardiovascular diseases, type 2 diabetes, and osteoporosis. Dietary habits of children and adolescents are frequently discussed in health policy debates due to their modifiability, making them viable targets for prevention and health promotion initiatives.

pmc-11478595.title: Biological and Molecular Characterization of a New Isolate of Tomato Mottle Mosaic Virus Causing Severe Shoestring and Fruit Deformities in Tomato Plants in India
pmc-11478595.creator: Prantik Mazumder, Firoz Mondal, Mehulee Sarkar, Anik Majumdar, Kajal Kumar Biswas, Susheel Kumar Sharma, Milan Kumar Lal, Rahul Kumar Tiwari, Ravinder Kumar, Anirban Roy, Anna Taglienti, Luca Ferretti
pmc-11478595.description: Tomato (Solanum lycopersicum L.), the second most important vegetable crop globally, faces a significant threat from various viral diseases. A newly emerging disease, characterised by distinctive shoestring symptoms on leaves and the development of unripe, small, and hard fruit, poses a serious challenge to tomato cultivation in India.

pmc-11573940.title: Integrated single-cell analysis reveals heterogeneity and therapeutic insights in osteosarcoma
pmc-11573940.creator: Dongan He, Xiaoqian Che, Haiming Zhang, Jiandong Guo, Lei Cai, Jian Li, Jinxi Zhang, Xin Jin, Jianfeng Wang
pmc-11573940.description: Osteosarcoma (OSA) is a primary bone malignancy characterized by its aggressive nature and high propensity for metastasis. Despite advancements in multimodal therapies, the clinical outcomes for OSA patients remain suboptimal, necessitating deeper molecular insights for improved therapeutic strategies. Here, we employed single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) to elucidate the cellular heterogeneity and transcriptional dynamics of OSA tumors.

pmc-12504431.title: Postpartum metabolomics profile predicts 8-years postdelivery women’s subclinical atherosclerosis measures
pmc-12504431.creator: Katherine Svensson, Marco Sanchez-Guerra, Vishal Midya, Haibin Guan, Megan Niedzwiecki, Georgia Dolios, Citlalli Osorio-Yáñez, Luz M. Del Razo, Julio C. Ayllon-Vergara, Guadalupe Estrada-Gutierrez, Maria Luisa Pizano Zárate, Lauren Petrick, Martha M. Téllez-Rojo, Robert O. Wright, Elena Colicino
pmc-12504431.description: This study evaluates women’s metabolomics profiles and subclinical measures of atherosclerosis. Pregnant women (< 20 weeks’﻿ gestation) living in Mexico City, Mexico, were recruited in 2007–2011 to the PROGRESS cohort. Serum untargeted metabolomics data at 1-month postpartum were analyzed using chromatography high-resolution mass spectrometry (LC-HRMS), and carotid intima media thickness (CIMT) was measured 8-years postdelivery using B-mode ultrasound.

pmc-12700020.title: Hybrid Revascularization Approach Using Robot-Assisted Bilateral Internal Mammary Artery Grafting
pmc-12700020.creator: Hugo Monteiro Neder Issa, Luciano Matar, Andre Shuster, Guilherme Athayde, Leticia Ferreira, Martin Bucek, Pedro Romanelli, Diogo Ferrari Centenaro, Joana Ferreira Hornestam, Arthur Monteiro Neder Issa, David Glineur
pmc-12700020.description: Hybrid coronary revascularization combines minimally invasive surgical coronary artery bypass grafting with percutaneous coronary intervention. This case report describes a 72-year-old male with multivessel coronary artery disease treated using a hybrid approach: robot-assisted bilateral internal mammary artery grafting followed by percutaneous coronary intervention. This method leverages the strengths of both modalities, offering tailored treatment for specific coronary lesions.

uslaw-usc-t42-s8008.title: 42 U.S.C. § 8008 — Funding procedures
uslaw-usc-t42-s8008.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t42-s8008.description: United States Code, Title 42 (The Public Health And Welfare); Chapter 89 (Congregate Housing Services). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) The Secretary shall establish procedures— (1) to assure timely payments to nonprofit corporations and public housing agencies for approved assisted congregate services programs with provision made for advance funding sufficient to meet necessary startup costs; (2) to permit reallocation of funds.
